name: Shawarma Sinbad
author: akramboussanni@users.noreply.github.com
description: Shawarma Sinbad Rails app with optional token-authenticated Cloudflare Tunnel. Databases and uploads live in /home/container/storage. With a tunnel, set its public hostname service to http://localhost:3000; no allocation is needed.

installation.script:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
mkdir -p /mnt/server/storage /mnt/server/log /mnt/server/tmp
echo "Application is bundled in the yolk; no download required."

variables.name: Rails master key
variables.description: Contents of config/master.key. Decrypts the app's production credentials.

variables.name: Admin password
variables.description: Password for the admin area. Choose a strong unique password.

variables.name: Cloudflare Tunnel token
variables.description: Token from a remotely managed Cloudflare Tunnel. Set its public hostname service to http://localhost:3000. Empty disables the tunnel and serves the app on the allocation port instead, which then requires an allocation.
